digest.component_or_area: bug tracking and source blame analysis
propositions: A new script must backfill caused_by links on existing closed bugs by reusing the conservative single-culprit blame resolver
The backfill script must check for existing active caused_by edges before writing new links to ensure idempotency
The script must default to --dry-run mode for safety and support explicit --write mode for actual persistence
The test must verify that exactly one caused_by link is drawn for single-culprit bugs while ambiguous bugs receive no links
Re-running the script in write mode must be a no-op when caused_by links already exist for a bug
The backfill implementation must use the same deterministic resolver as live auto-derivation to ensure consistency
